exact: FGF receptor signaling pathway involved in positive regulation of cell proliferation in bone marrow
FGFR signaling pathway involved in positive regulation of cell proliferation in bone marrow
fibroblast growth factor receptor signalling pathway involved in positive regulation of cell proliferation in bone marrow

definition: The series of molecular signals generated as a consequence of a fibroblast growth factor receptor binding to one of its physiological ligands, which activates or increases the frequency, rate or extent of cell proliferation in the bone marrow.
label: fibroblast growth factor receptor signaling pathway involved in positive regulation of cell proliferation in bone marrow
